title: malaxis liliifolia
intro: Malaxis liliifolia, commonly known as Yellow Adder's Mouth, is a species of orchid native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis liliifolia include its ability to relax the respiratory tract, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
